reviews.title: Last 3 years all gone
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for almost a decade now. I found it back when I was in college. Since then, I’ve used it every day. I have ADHD so I must write everything down or else I’d forget it. I’ve used this for all tasks, reminders, etc. however when I updated the app recently, it logged me out. When I logged back in, everything from the last 4 years was gone. My most recent tasks are things I’ve had from 2020 or 2021. I’ve never had an issue like this and it’s pretty devastating to realize all the reminders and tasks I’ve had for myself for the last 4 years are completely gone. I wish there was a way to back up the app or something to prevent this from happening again.

reviews.title: Great but slow and getting slower

reviews.title: Very Ugly
reviews.text:
I tried 24me and I just couldn’t get round the visual awfulness of it.

Everything has the feeling of a beta-testing app which might be fairly functional, feature-wise, but nobody has put any thought in visual accessibility.

Because this is such a friction point for me, I couldn’t really get past that.

reviews.title: Can't Add Events
reviews.text: Doesnt allow you to use the app without giving full access to your original iPhone calendar. The whole point of having a separate calendar app is so I don't have to mix up my events. That doesn't work if you require me to use them as one.

reviews.title: Free very limited Frustrating but nice ideas
reviews.text: Costs $30 to access full calendar and be able to ad more than 2 reminders, dates and times jump around too easily, had to keep fixing, MOST FRUSTRATING OF ALL: please developers just block the parts that cost money instead of making me think I can ad a location on the map and then I type it in n u keep nagging about a buying $30 for a calendar. It’s nice ideas but it’s not worth$30. Sucks bc I just got a traumatic brain injury and need a calendar like this to help, great ideas, but it is too sensitive n doesn’t auto save. I will be deleting n searching for a new calendar to help me. I don’t like apple calendar bc it always fails to remind me and is too plain n limited.

reviews.title: Hard to navigate
reviews.text: Cannot use it without allowing it to access your other calendar app. Whats the point of getting another one if it needs my old one? Cannot invite or learn how to invite easily. Ugly.

reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for years, I got in while they had a lifetime pro deal going on. They have typically been very responsive to letting them know about problems but it’s been over a year of the app not working with my Apple Watch. It always says no events for today, no matter how many are on my calendar. A couple months ago I reached out over a different bug, when I change the date of a recurring event there’s a pop-up that asks if you want to change it for this one instance or all instances in the future. Clicking future used to update all the ones in the future, but now it isn’t. I’ve reached out a couple times about it, the last two times with no response. And things get duplicated. It shows up twice in your calendar but when you delete one, they are both gone. The same bugs have plagued this app for years. Probably time for me to move on to a different calendar app.
